recipes.name: Clay-Roasted Thigh inspired by Hannibal
ingredients: 4 pounds non toxic, non polymer, oven hardening clay
4 medium sized pieces of tong sum
1 large beef marrow bone, halved lengthwise
instructions: Combine the dried dong quai, tong sum and the shiitake mushrooms in a blender or food processor and process until they become a fine powder. - ½ cup dong quai - 4 medium sized pieces of tong sum - ½ cup dried shiitake mushrooms

Reconstitute the longan flesh, gocce berries and the rest of the shiitake mushrooms for 15 minutes in hot water, then dry thoroughly. - ½ cup dried longan flesh - ½ cup dried gocce berries - ½ cup dried shiitake mushrooms
Cut pork loin in half and trim fat and silverskin. Butterfly each piece. - 1 whole pork loin
Generously season both sides with salt and ground pepper. Then sprinkle the inside of each piece with the root and mushroom seasoning mixture. - Salt - Fresh ground pepper

Place a generous heap of reconstituted longan flesh, gocce berries, and shiitake mushrooms on the inside of one piece. Then add halved shallots and garlic cloves. Place the other piece of pork loin on top. - 3 cloves garlic halved
Shingle the top of the roast with prosciutto. - 3 ounces prosciutto
Tie the whole roast tight with butcher's twine.
Double wrap roast with lotus leaves. - 2 large reconstituted lotus leaves

Lay down a bottom layer of clay larger than the roast on a baking sheet and place the roast on top. Then begin shingling the top of the roast with clay to create two layers that you can join together to create a sealed package. - 4 pounds non toxic non polymer, oven hardening clay
Once covered, create a ventilation hole on the top and place the roast in a 275°F oven for 3 1/2 hours.
Set roast aside and turn oven up to 450°F and roast beef bones for 15 minutes
Break open the clay on roast with a pestle and peel off the clay in large pieces.
Peel open the lotus leaves and cut a few of the strings off.

Serve with beef marrow bone drizzled with a vinaigrette of olive oil, parsley, finely chopped shallot and white wine vinegar. - 1 large beef marrow bone halved lengthwise - ¼ cup olive oil - ¼ cup parsley - 9 shallots peeled and halved - Butcher's twine
